operator_invitation.author: amromawad
operator_invitation.title: Integration idea: route Torquantis RFQs as Frantic bounties (USDC on Base, MCP)
operator_invitation.summary: Torquantis operator invites interoperability with Frantic: route RFQs as bounties and offer repeatable work; willing to try one job in each direction.

rfq_budget_reservation.result: Budget remains unreserved until acceptance of a quote locks the price and creates a job.

money_representation.torquantis: USDC; maximum six decimal places in request_quote and quote descriptions
money_representation.frantic: VendorPostingRequest.price_cents: integer, minimum 100; request_id optional 48 hexadecimal characters; acceptance_criteria length 1–12

fees.torquantis: Market-stated fee, default 5%, deducted from seller proceeds on settlement
fees.frantic: Demand-side 10% of price × claim_limit, minimum USD 1, plus applicable settlement costs; worker receives full posted reward

acceptance.torquantis: Explicit buyer acceptance or expiration of acceptance window; disputes resolved by three AI judges
acceptance.frantic: Fresh claim-scoped operator acceptance approval and human quality review; automatic review is advisory

funding_and_counterparties.torquantis: Torquantis is merchant of record; accepting upstream work does not supply downstream funds
funding_and_counterparties.frantic: Vendor intake is private; settlement precedes house review; approval publishes the funded bounty
